title: Compiler readiness observations and recovery accounting
summary: Count actual compiler repair failures separately from health observations and coordinate compiler output writers with readiness readers.
reusable_steps: Count actual compiler repair failures separately from health observations and coordinate compiler output writers with readiness readers
expected_outcome: Health probes must not consume an L2 recovery budget. Count each failed compiler command once, and reset only after all expected compiler outputs are ready. Serialize compiler output mutation and defer readiness observations during builds. Source-only build and cleanup entrypoints must work without dist. Forward cooperative termination to compiler children and wait before unlocking; forced SIGKILL is outside this guarantee. Diagnose DNS, credential-store access, missing credentials, and confirmed server rejection separately. CLI warnings alone do not prove rejection; connector authentication is independent. Preserve generic GitHub failure categories and redact credential evidence.
